title: calopogon tuberosus var. latifolius
intro: Calopogon tuberosus var. latifolius, commonly known as the large yellow grass-pink, is a type of orchid native to North America. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents present in Calopogon tuberosus var. latifolius are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various ailments.
